packageRules.description: Each Consul release accepts only some Envoy branches. Bump Consul and envoyproxy together so the shipped Envoy stays on an upstream-supported branch.
prBodyNotes: Envoy compatibility: check `envoyextensions/xdscommon/ENVOY_VERSIONS` at the new tag. The shipped envoyproxy (zextras/envoyproxy) must be in that range. If the range changes, update the `envoyproxy<…` conflict in `consul/PKGBUILD`, and in zextras/envoyproxy update the `service-discover-base<…` conflict and the Renovate `allowedVersions` cap. Envoy branch support dates: https://github.com/envoyproxy/envoy/blob/main/RELEASES.md
